Checkout confirmation copy (DRAFT, local only)

Locale and tone: British English, calm tone.
Basis: precedent P-1 ("Use calm British English for checkout copy. Keep existing product claims; new promises require separate approval."), confirmed on card t_a024651b by the unblock comment with the same ruling.

Placeholders in [square brackets] must be filled from the live order data. Do not invent values.

---

Subject line: Thank you for your order

Heading: Thank you, [first name]. Your order is confirmed.

Body:
We have received your order [order number] and it is now confirmed. A summary of what you bought, and the amount charged, is set out below.

Order summary
[Item name] x [quantity] ........ [line price]
Total ........................... [order total]

Delivery
[Insert only the delivery details that already appear on the live product or checkout page, for example the dispatch method and address. Do not add new timings.]

What happens next
We will send you a separate email when your order has been dispatched. If you need to change or query your order, reply to this email or contact us at [support contact], quoting your order number.

Sign-off:
With thanks,
[Brand name] customer care

---

Editorial checklist
[ ] British spelling and conventions throughout (for example "dispatched", "organise", "postcode", "£").
[ ] Calm, plain tone: no exclamation marks, no slang, no playful phrasing.
[ ] No new product claims, promises, guarantees or timings beyond those already published. Any new promise needs separate approval.
[ ] Every [placeholder] is filled from live order data before sending; none left blank.
[ ] Order number, totals and item names match the checkout record.
[ ] Support contact matches the address currently published.
[ ] Not sent, published or placed on any live site. Review and approval required before use.
